sources.observation: The cross of weathered brown log arms has a continuous steep shingle roof. The belfry is linked to the nave by a low covered range.
Pale shingle skirts separate the brown lower belfry from white chevrons and a red band of diamonds. The roof steps into an octagonal lantern and a slender spire.

limitations: Heights, timber details and roof slopes are photo-based estimates. The model covers the linked exterior and retains the surrounding map paths and shoreline.
